name: exponential-decay
title: Exponential decay (AMICI/CVODES, compiled)
question: Driven as a process-bigraph process, does AMICI compile a single-species decay model and integrate it to the analytic exponential solution?
hypothesis: Running dA/dt = -kA (k = 0.2, A0 = 10) through the AMICI bridge compiles the model to native C++ and integrates it with CVODES to A(5) = 10*exp(-1) = 3.6788, strictly monotone decreasing, within solver tolerance.
objective: Demonstrate end to end that pbg_amici.composites.exponential_decay.amici_exponential_decay compiles and runs the real AMICI/CVODES engine and emits a correct time-series, with AMICI acting as a pluggable process-bigraph process.
description: The basic-functionality showcase for viva-amici. AMICI translates the Antimony decay model to C++, compiles a native extension, and CVODES integrates it. Over a 5-unit run (interval 1.0) the state A falls 10.0 -> 8.187 -> 6.703 -> 5.488 -> ... -> 3.6788, matching the closed-form 10*exp(-0.2*t) to ~7 digits.

expected_behavior.name: matches-analytic-decay
expected_behavior.en: The integrated final concentration matches the analytic exponential solution A0*exp(-k*T) to within 1 percent, and the trajectory is strictly decreasing.
expected_behavior.condition: after a 5-unit run with k = 0.2, A0 = 10
expected_behavior.rationale: First-order decay has the exact solution A(t) = A0*exp(-kt); a correct compile + CVODES integration must reproduce it to solver tolerance.

behavior_tests.name: matches-analytic-decay
behavior_tests.description: |A(5) - 10*exp(-1)| / (10*exp(-1)) < 0.01 and the trajectory is strictly monotone decreasing (observed A(5) = 3.678794 vs analytic 3.678794, relative error 2.0e-7).

findings.name: analytic-match
findings.statement: AMICI compiled the decay model to native C++ and CVODES integrated it to A(5) = 3.678794 against the analytic 3.678794 (relative error 2.0e-7), strictly monotone decreasing from A0 = 10.
findings.provenance: Observed in an isolated-venv run of the exponential_decay composite on pbg-amici @ main (commit 63ce10b) / AMICI 1.2.0 (Apple clang), 2026-11-27 (reproduced by sims/run.py).

conclusion: PASS. Run as a process-bigraph process, AMICI compiled the single-species decay model and CVODES integrated it to the analytic exponential solution within 2e-7 relative error, strictly monotone decreasing. AMICI behaves as a drop-in process-bigraph compiled-ODE engine.

derived.insight: AMICI compiled the decay model to native C++ and CVODES integrated it to A(5) = 3.678794 against the analytic 3.678794 (relative error 2.0e-7), strictly monotone decreasing from A0 = 10.
